coverage.multiset_numerator: sum over output-unit types of min(output count, prompt count)
coverage.orientation: fraction of output units recoverable from prompt units
coverage.type_numerator: distinct output types also present in prompt

empty_strings: permitted by feature functions and mapped through explicit zero-denominator rules; canonical cohort requires non-empty actual text

output_diagnostics.bigram_repeat_fraction: 1 - distinct output word bigrams / output word bigrams
output_diagnostics.self_bits_per_byte: mean calibrated zlib-9/bz2-9/lzma-preset-9 output-only bits / UTF-8 output bytes
output_diagnostics.type_token_ratio: distinct output word tokens / output word tokens

rouge_l_recall: exact Hunt-Szymanski word-token LCS length divided by output-token count
source_protocol: audited feature semantics from heuristic_overlap_pilot.py protocol version 1

text.whitespace_normalization: collapse Unicode whitespace to one ASCII space and strip

ties: retained exactly; Spearman uses average midranks
